title: maint.event.v1{kind=retrain_request}
description: Phase 6.3 drift agent → trainer + scaler. Existing kind, formalized as a per-kind sub-schema in Phase 8 §8.0 to satisfy the oneOf-on-kind discipline. Drift agent fires when a predictor's rolling Brier/log-loss window breaches `cfg.drift_accuracy_floor` OR a KS-test on input features rejects stationarity at `cfg.drift_pvalue`. The scaler consumes the same kind to pre-warm capacity (does NOT pull the trigger on weights — trainer is action-of-record).
